Perkins County

Contact
Julie Sestak
Treasurer
(308) 352-7570
(308) 352-7562- Fax
jsestak@perkinscounty.ne.gov
Office Hours
8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Mailing Address
PO Box 357
Grant, NE 69140
Location
200 Lincoln Ave
Grant, NE 69140
Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate, personal taxes and NRD occupational tax in the County
Register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
To issue driver licenses, CDL.’s, learner permits, ID cards, school permits, etc.
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
